name: t9e2e-webapp
description: React single-page app for the shared task board. Signs users in via Thunder, shows the full task list to any signed-in user, and lets Admins create tasks and mark them complete via t9e2e-api. Holds no data of its own and never talks to the database directly.

dependencies.name: t9e2e-api
dependencies.description: Reads and writes tasks on the shared board.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs users in via Thunder before they can see or use the board.
